q: 최근 라운드들에서 벌타를 모두 몇 타 받았어?

sql: SELECT avg(strokes) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_hole WHERE par = 5

q: 가장 잘 친 라운드의 총 타수는?

sql: SELECT sum(green_rate * shots) / sum(shots) FROM lakehouse.gold.shot_outcome_by_distance WHERE distance_bucket = '130-160'
SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_hole_shot WHERE lie = 'OB'
SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_hole WHERE putts >= 3

q: 드라이버 페어웨이 안착률이 가장 높았던 라운드 날짜는?
sql: SELECT substr(played_at, 1, 10) FROM lakehouse.gold.driver_dispersion ORDER BY fairway_rate DESC LIMIT 1
